title: Tenma Saki — The Yummiest Drink!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Does that mean our song worked...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I think so!
No, I know so!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Hehe. I'm glad we decided to write that song!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, Saki! Are you on your way home too?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Also, you seem to be in a cheery mood.
Did your show go that well?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Really?! The brother and sister made up?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Pretty sure they did, and I really hope so!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's great...!
Good for you, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What else did we talk about during our debrief...? Oh, giving our performances more depth...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Pretty sure Shiho mentioned how we modulate our sound well in terms of what our sheet music says, but we can do more to give our songs more life...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And for me to do that, I have to...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay!
That should be everything we talked about.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I know we still have a lot to do to make our shows better, but this one was so...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Our song ended up working because Ichi wrote such amazing lyrics for it.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I mean, she wrote and rewrote it so many times...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (And when she finally let us read them, I was on the verge of bursting into tears.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I was pretty much crying...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi's so incredible.
I wanna learn to write really moving songs like her too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... How would I want it to go...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Something that's touching but only I can come up with...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Why did you change out my dolls with those...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No! You definitely have! If you did, you never would've done something like this...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I get that you're a forgetter, but I never thought you'd ever forget about that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's it! A song that gives people the courage to apologize after having a big fight!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, I'll jot that down and work on it when I have some free time♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Shiho even said so herself.
It's important for us to gain experience playing shows, but we need to start thinking about taking the next step.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Especially if we want to really get our name out there!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Someday, if we can get a huge crowd going by playing the music we wrote...!)
